meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Wakad | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: JEE coaching in Wakad at our branch in Swami Vivekanand Nagar. Faculty from Kota, {{fact:batch.days}}, {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}.

intro: Our Wakad branch is in Swami Vivekanand Nagar, so students who live in Wakad have a centre in their own neighbourhood.

sections.heading: Coming to the branch
body: The branch is on the first floor of the Shiv Malhar building.

body.text: Three BRT routes run close to Wakad: Nashik Phata to Wakad, Aundh to Ravet, and Kalewadi Phata to Dehu Alandi. That gives students a bus as well as a car or two-wheeler.

sections.heading: Who studies at Wakad

body.text: Students come to us from schools across Wakad, and from Sangvi, Pimple Gurav and Aundh too.

body: The Wakad branch is also the nearer centre for families in Hinjewadi, Baner, Balewadi and Pashan, on the far side of the river.

body.text: A two-year programme from Class 11 and a one-year programme for Class 12, taught in the evening after school.

questions.q: Where exactly is the Wakad centre?
questions.a: In Swami Vivekanand Nagar, on the first floor of Shiv Malhar. [The branch page](page:centre-wakad) has the address and directions.

questions.q: Can a Wakad student go to the head office instead?
questions.a: Yes. Both centres teach JEE {{fact:batch.days}}, from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}.

a.text: Three BRT routes pass close to Wakad, including Nashik Phata to Wakad.
